ai_summary: Aarti Pharmalabs Limited has announced Tuesday, September 15, 2026, as the Record Date for its recommended final dividend of ₹2.00 per equity share (40%) for Fiscal Year 2025-26. This dividend payment is contingent upon shareholder approval at the Annual General Meeting on September 22, 2026, and, if approved, eligible shareholders will receive payment on or before October 20, 2026. This is a standard regulatory disclosure indicating a planned return to shareholders, with no apparent red flags.
